info.title: Laji API
info.description:
## Authentication

This API requires an **Access Token**. To obtain a token:
1. [Send a `POST` request with your email address to the `/api-user` endpoint](https://api.laji.fi/openapi#/API%20user/ApiUsersController_register).
2. An access token will be sent to your email.

Include the token in all requests using the HTTP header: `Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>`

Here on the API frontpage, you can configure the **Access Token**, **Person-Token**, and **Accept-Language** globally using the **Authorize** button below.

---

## Documentation & Resources

- **Additional API documentation:**
  [https://info.laji.fi/en/frontpage/api/api-laji-fi](https://info.laji.fi/en/frontpage/api/api-laji-fi)

- **OpenAPI / Swagger 3.0 specification (machine-readable):**
  [https://api.laji.fi/openapi-json](https://api.laji.fi/openapi-json)

---

## Support

If you have any questions, contact us at **helpdesk@laji.fi**.

operation.description: Submit polygons in various coordinate reference systems and in GeoJSON or WKT format, and get id of the polygon which can be given to polygonId search filter.

parameters.name: Person-Token
parameters.description: Person token is required to limit number of created polygon ids per day to 100

parameters.name: crs
parameters.description: Give coordinate reference system of the GeoJSON or WKT. Defaults to EUREF. (WGS84 = EPSG:4326; EUREF = ETRS-TM35FIN EPSG:3067; YKJ = EPSG:2393)

parameters.name: geoJSON
parameters.description: Either this or wkt is required. The polygon as GeoJSON.

parameters.name: wkt
parameters.description: Either this or geoJSON is required. The polygon as WKT.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Alternative way to Accept header to define content type of the response.

400.description: Parameters were not accepted. Message has details.

429.description: User limit per day was exceeded.

500.description: Service is in unknown erroneous state.
